items:
⭐ More than a Stay™. Elite VIP Experience Package – Enjoy daily FREE Golf, Parasailing, Crab Island Excursion, Sunset Dolphin Cruise, Water Park, Bikes and More Activities EVERY DAY of Your Stay! Up to $1,150 in daily value. (Details Below) ⭐

Experience Summer Lane, a modern masterpiece perfectly positioned just one block from the serene shores of Santa Rosa Beach. This newly built home combines sleek, contemporary design with luxurious amenities, ensuring every detail enhances your vacation. Whether lounging by your private heated pool, cruising to the beach in the 6-passenger golf cart, or savoring sunsets from the westward-facing balcony, Summer Lane offers an unmatched retreat for relaxation and fun.

Inside, elegance meets comfort across three thoughtfully designed floors. The first floor sets the tone with a cozy living area, wet bar, and a king bedroom that flows effortlessly to the patio and pool. On the second floor, a gourmet kitchen and spacious dining area invite memorable meals, while the king suite with balcony access offers a private haven. The third floor is perfect for larger groups, featuring multiple bedrooms, a coffee bar, and a bunk room that brings a playful yet functional touch.

Outdoors, indulge in the sparkling pool, grill your favorite meals, and unwind with plenty of seating for dining or lounging. With its proximity to the beach, restaurants, and shops, Summer Lane is more than just a destination—it's an invitation to experience the best of the Emerald Coast.

WHY GUESTS 💙 SUMMER LANE:
🔹 Includes a Street-Legal 6-Passenger Golf Cart
🔹 2 Minute Golf Cart Ride to the Beach
🔹 Private Heated* Pool
🔹 Elevator
🔹 Dog Friendly*
🔹 West Facing Balcony for Amazing Sunsets
🔹 Outdoor Grill & Dining Area
🔹 Includes 2 Bikes
🔹 4 Beach Chairs Provided in the Home
🔹 Beach Towels Provided

🩴👙 THE LIVING EXPERIENCE:

🔹 FIRST FLOOR EXPERIENCE: (Sleeps 2)
The first floor welcomes you with a mix of convenience and relaxation. A cozy living area with a wet bar, mini fridge, microwave, and coffee maker provides the perfect spot to unwind, while the patio and private heated pool offer an inviting outdoor retreat. A king bedroom with access to a full bathroom and a walk-in shower ensures restful accommodations, while the elevator adds easy access to all levels of the home.

- Elevator
- Access to Patio, Private Heated Pool and Grill
- Living Area with Wet Bar, Mini Fridge, Microwave and Coffee Maker
- King Bedroom
- Full Bathroom

🔹SECOND FLOOR EXPERIENCE: (Sleeps 2)
The second floor is the heart of the home, designed for gathering and entertaining. A gourmet kitchen with a large island and seating for five flows seamlessly into the dining area, which seats eight comfortably. The spacious living room opens to a balcony, perfect for enjoying the fresh air, while the king bedroom with an en-suite bathroom and private balcony access offers a luxurious retreat.

- Gourmet Kitchen with Large Island and Seating for 5
- Large Dining Table with Seating for 8
- Living Room with Access to the Balcony
- King Bedroom with Balcony Access and an En-suite Bathroom

🔹THIRD FLOOR EXPERIENCE: (Sleeps 10)
The third floor is ideal for larger groups, with thoughtfully designed sleeping arrangements and amenities. A coffee bar and balcony access from the hall create a welcoming space to start your day. The king bedroom with balcony access and an en-suite bathroom provides a serene escape, while the bunk room and king bedroom share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom. A double full bedroom with its own en-suite bathroom ensures comfort and privacy, and the laundry room adds convenience to this level.

- Balcony Access from the Hall
- Coffee Bar
- King Bedroom with Balcony Access and an En-suite Bathroom
- Bunk Room with 4 Built-In Twins and a Jack-and-Jill Bathroom
- King Bedroom with a Jack-and-Jill Bathroom
- Double Full Bedroom with an En-suite Bathroom
- Laundry Room

🔹PARKING: This home can accommodate 4-6 vehicles, depending on size. Please note that street and sidewalk parking is not permitted.

🏖️ THE BEACH EXPERIENCE:

Enjoy a seamless beach day at Ed Walline Regional Beach, where accessibility and convenience are top priorities. The fully ADA-accessible beach is just a short 4-minute walk or a quick 2-minute golf cart ride from Summer Lane. Facilities include two spacious picnic shelters, parking, restrooms, and beach wheelchairs during peak season to ensure everyone can comfortably enjoy the sand and surf. Also during peak season, attentive lifeguards are on duty to keep you safe while you relax, build sandcastles, or take a refreshing dip in the water.

⛵ THE VIP EXPERIENCE​​​​​​​:

⭐ Your vacation should be EPIC— so vacation like a VIP with FREE activities every day!

Elevate your vacation with the Elite Experience Package, designed for those who seek adventure, relaxation, and unforgettable memories. As our guest, you'll enjoy up to $1,150 in complimentary daily activities—because your getaway should be nothing short of extraordinary.

🔹Two Tickets Per Day For:
🏖️ Big Kahuna's Water Park – Splash into fun with slides, wave pools & lazy rivers
⛳ Glow-in-the-Dark Mini Golf – A unique indoor putting adventure
🐬 Dolphin Cruise, Sunset Cruise & Snorkeling – Choose your perfect ocean excursion
🧗 Indoor Air Adventure Park – Platinum access to trampolines, climbing walls & more
🚲 Two Complimentary Bikes – Explore the area at your own pace

🔹One Ticket Per Day For:
🌴 Crab Island Tiki Boat Cruise – Cruise to the famous sandbar on a floating tiki bar
🏌️ Championship Golf Rounds – Tee off at Emerald Bay, Regatta Bay, Shalimar Pointe, or Windswept Dunes
🪂 Parasailing – Soar high above the Gulf for breathtaking views
🎣 Fishing Excursion – Reel in Snapper, Grouper & more

✨ 10+ Free Activities Daily | Up to $1,150 Value | No Extra Cost – Just Our Gift to You! You'll receive all the details on reserving your activities in your confirmation email. Please note, some activities may be seasonal.

🌞 DREAM VACATION, ENHANCED:
✔️ Dogs are welcome with a $200 non-refundable pet fee per dog.
✔️ *Pool heating is available for $50 per day (payment required for the duration of your stay).
✔️ High-speed, reliable internet to ensure you stay connected for work or streaming.
✔️ Access to live TV on every TV, featuring a wide selection of movies, shows, sports, and news for endless entertainment.
✔️ A personalized welcome and/or thoughtful gift provided during your stay.
✔️ Convenient starter packs provided with essentials such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dish soap, shampoos, and laundry detergent. (Additional items may need to be purchased)
✔️ Fresh, clean, and soft linens are provided for every stay, laundered in our in-house facility after each check-out.
✔️ Peace of mind with a $3,000 accidental damage waiver (with a $100 deductible). Some exclusions apply.
✔️ VIP services available for an added touch of convenience, including babysitting, grocery delivery, entertainment options, & more.

🐟 MEET YOUR HOST:

Destin Dreamers is your go-to choice for luxury vacation rentals in Destin, Miramar Beach, and 30A. Our motto, “Celebrating life, dreaming fully awake,” reflects our true way of life. For us, every day is a gift from God, and we cherish the time spent with friends and family. While it may seem simple, living fully awake and embracing each moment is something we consciously strive for. After thriving as a custom home builder in Colorado for 15 years, Chris Harper and his family moved to the stunning Emerald Coast. It was here that Destin Dreamers was born. Our vision is clear: to offer guests the chance to celebrate life, dreaming fully awake.

Our dedicated team is available on-site daily or reachable via call or text from 8 AM to 5 PM, six days a week, with support for emergencies on Sundays and after hours.

*Person booking must be over 25 and stay each night. No exceptions. See rental agreement for more info.

*Please be aware that some furniture may have been updated since the last photos were taken.
